sentences.text: jacinta : Hello, Easy Life Cleaning Services, Jacinta speaking.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 您好，这里是易生活清洁服务公司，我是杰辛塔。

sentences.text: client : Oh hello.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 哦，您好。

sentences.text: I'm looking for a cleaning service for my apartment – do you do domestic cleaning?
sentences.zh: 我在为我的公寓寻找一家清洁服务公司——你们提供家庭清洁服务吗？

sentences.text: jacinta : Sure.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 当然可以。

sentences.text: client : Well, it's just a one-bedroom flat.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 嗯，这只是间一居室的公寓。

sentences.text: Do you have a basic cleaning package?
sentences.zh: 你们有基础清洁套餐吗？

sentences.text: jacinta : Yes.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 有的。

sentences.text: For a one-bedroom flat we're probably looking at about two hours for a clean.
sentences.zh: 针对一居室公寓，我们通常需要大约两个小时来完成一次清洁。

sentences.text: So we'd do a thorough clean of all surfaces in each room, and polish them where necessary.
sentences.zh: 我们会彻底清洁每个房间内所有表面，并在必要时进行抛光。

sentences.text: Does your apartment have carpets?
sentences.zh: 您的公寓铺有地毯吗？

sentences.text: client : No, I don't have any, but the floor would need cleaning .
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 没有，我那里没有地毯，但地板需要清洁。

sentences.text: jacinta : Of course – we'd do that in every room.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 当然可以——我们会清洁每个房间的地板。

sentences.text: And we'd do a thorough clean of the kitchen and bathroom.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们也会对厨房和浴室进行彻底清洁。

sentences.text: client : OK.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 好的。

sentences.text: jacinta : Then we have some additional services which you can request if you want – so for example, we can clean your oven for you every week.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 此外，我们还提供一些可选的附加服务——例如，我们可以每周为您清洁烤箱。

sentences.text: client : Actually, I hardly ever use that, but can you do the fridge?
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 其实我几乎从不使用烤箱，但你们能帮我清洁冰箱吗？

sentences.text: jacinta : Sure.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 当然可以。

sentences.text: Would you like that done every week?
sentences.zh: 您希望每周都做这项服务吗？

sentences.text: client : Yes, definitely.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 是的，一定要。

sentences.text: And would ironing clothes be an additional service you can do?
sentences.zh: 那么熨烫衣物也是你们可提供的附加服务吗？

sentences.text: jacinta : Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 是的，当然可以。

sentences.text: client : It wouldn't be much, just my shirts for work that week.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 工作服衬衫数量不多，就只是当周穿的几件而已。

sentences.text: jacinta : That's fine.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 没问题。

sentences.text: And we could also clean your microwave if you want.
sentences.zh: 如果您需要，我们还可以清洁微波炉。

sentences.text: client : No, I wipe that out pretty regularly so there's no need for that.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 不用了，我经常擦拭，所以没必要。

sentences.text: jacinta : We also offer additional services that you might want a bit less often, say every month.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 我们还提供一些您可能不需要太频繁使用的附加服务，比如每月一次。

sentences.text: So for example, if the inside of your windows need cleaning, we could do that.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果您的窗户内侧需要清洁，我们可以为您处理。

sentences.text: client : Yes, that'd be good.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 是的，这很好。

sentences.text: I'm on the fifteenth floor, so the outside gets done regularly by specialists, but the inside does get a bit grubby.
sentences.zh: 我住在十五楼，因此窗户外部会由专业人员定期清洁，但内侧确实有点脏。

sentences.text: jacinta : And we could arrange for your curtains to get cleaned if necessary.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 如果需要，我们也可以安排清洁您的窗帘。

sentences.text: client : No, they're OK.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 不用了，窗帘目前还好。

sentences.text: But would you be able to do something about the balcony?
sentences.zh: 不过，你们能帮忙处理一下阳台吗？

sentences.text: It's quite small and I don't use it much, but it could do with a wash every month or so.
sentences.zh: 它很小，我也不怎么使用，但大概每月清洗一次会比较好。

sentences.text: jacinta : Yes, we can get the pressure washer onto that.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 是的，我们可以用高压水枪来清洗。

sentences.text: jacinta : Now if you're interested, we do offer some other possibilities to do with general maintenance.
sentences.zh: JACINTA: 现在，如果您感兴趣的话，我们还提供一些与日常维护相关的其他服务选项。

sentences.text: For example, if you have a problem with water and you need a plumber in a hurry, we can put you in touch with a reliable one who can come out straightaway.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果您遇到水管问题，急需一位可靠的水管工，我们可以立即为您联系一位能马上上门的师傅。

sentences.text: And the same thing if you need an electrician.
sentences.zh: 同样地，如果您需要电工，我们也能提供相应协助。

sentences.text: client : Right.
sentences.zh: CLIENT: 明白了。

sentences.text: That's good to know.
sentences.zh: 这很有帮助。

sentences.text: I've only just moved here so I don't have any of those sorts of contacts.
sentences.zh: 我才刚搬来这里，还没有这类人脉资源。

sentences.text: jacinta : And I don't know if this is of interest to you, but we also offer a special vacuum cleaning system which can improve the indoor air quality of your home by capturing up to 99% of all the dust in the air.
sentences.zh: jacinta : 而且我不知道这是否会引起您的兴趣，但我们还提供一种特殊的吸尘清洁系统，可通过捕获空气中高达99%的灰尘来改善您家中的室内空气质量。

sentences.text: So if you're troubled by allergies, this can make a big difference.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果您受过敏问题困扰，这将带来很大改善。

sentences.text: client : Right.
sentences.zh: client : 好的。

sentences.text: In fact, I don't have that sort of problem, but I'll bear it in mind.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我本人并没有这类问题，但我会把这点记在心里。

sentences.text: Now can you tell me a bit about your cleaning staff?
sentences.zh: 那么，您能向我简单介绍一下你们的清洁人员吗？

sentences.text: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts jacinta : Of course.
sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts jacinta : 当然可以。

sentences.text: So all our cleaners are very carefully selected.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的清洁人员都经过非常严格的筛选。

sentences.text: When they apply to us, they have to undergo a security check with the police to make sure they don't have any sort of criminal background, and, of course, they have to provide references as well.
sentences.zh: 当他们向我们申请职位时，必须接受警方的安全背景审查，以确保其没有任何犯罪记录；当然，他们还需提供推荐信。

sentences.text: Then if we think they might be suitable for the job, we give them training for it.
sentences.zh: 然后，如果我们认为他们可能适合该岗位，便会为他们提供岗前培训。

sentences.text: That lasts for two weeks so it's very thorough, and at the end of it, they have a test.
sentences.zh: 培训为期两周，内容非常全面；培训结束时，他们还需通过一项考核。

sentences.text: If they pass that, we take them on, but we monitor them very carefully – we ask all our clients to complete a review of their performance after every visit and to email it to us.
sentences.zh: 如果他们顺利通过考核，我们便会正式聘用他们；但我们会对其进行非常严密的监督——我们要求所有客户每次服务结束后都填写一份关于其工作表现的评价，并通过电子邮件发送给我们。

sentences.text: So we can pick up any problems straightaway and deal with them.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能立即发现任何问题并及时处理。

sentences.text: client : OK, well that all sounds good.
sentences.zh: client : 好的，听起来都很不错。

sentences.text: And will I always have the same cleaner?
sentences.zh: 那我以后会一直由同一位清洁人员服务吗？

sentences.text: jacinta : Yes, we do our best to organise it that way, and we usually manage it.
sentences.zh: jacinta : 是的，我们会尽力安排如此，而且通常都能做到。

sentences.text: client : Good.
sentences.zh: client : 很好。

sentences.text: That's fine.
sentences.zh: 这没问题。

sentences.text: Right, so I'd like to go ahead and …
sentences.zh: 好的，那么我想现在就……

sentences.text: As many of you here today have worked in the hotel industry for some time, I'm sure you have experienced the problem of high staff turnover in your hotels.
sentences.zh: 在座各位中，许多人已在酒店行业工作了一段时间，我相信你们一定经历过酒店员工高流动率的问题。

sentences.text: Every hotel relies on having loyal and experienced members of staff who make sure that everything runs smoothly.
sentences.zh: 每家酒店都依赖忠诚且经验丰富的员工，以确保一切运营顺畅。

sentences.text: If staff are constantly changing, it can make life difficult for everyone.
sentences.zh: 如果员工频繁更替，会给所有人带来诸多困难。

sentences.text: But why do staff leave frequently in many hotels?
sentences.zh: 但为什么许多酒店的员工会频繁离职呢？

sentences.text: Of course, many hotel jobs, such as cleaning, are low-skilled and are not well-paid.
sentences.zh: 当然，许多酒店岗位（例如清洁工作）属于低技能岗位，且薪酬不高。

sentences.text: A lot of managers think it's this and the long hours that are the main causes of high staff turnover – but what they don't realise is that it's the lack of training in many hotel jobs which is a huge factor.
sentences.zh: 很多管理者认为，正是这一点以及长时间工作，是导致员工高流动率的主要原因；但他们没有意识到的是，酒店许多岗位缺乏培训才是一个巨大的影响因素。

sentences.text: So, what kind of problems does a high turnover of staff cause?
sentences.zh: 那么，员工高流动率会引发哪些问题呢？

sentences.text: Well, having to recruit new staff all the time can be very time-consuming, and managers may have to cover some duties while waiting for new staff to arrive.
sentences.zh: 首先，持续招聘新员工会耗费大量时间；而等待新员工到岗期间，管理人员可能不得不临时承担部分工作职责。

sentences.text: This means they don't have time to think about less immediate problems such as how to improve their service.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们无暇思考一些不那么紧迫的问题，例如如何提升服务质量。

sentences.text: When staff leave, it can also severely affect the colleagues they leave behind.
sentences.zh: 员工离职还会严重影响他们留下的同事。

sentences.text: It has a negative effect on remaining staff, who may start to feel that they too should be thinking about leaving.
sentences.zh: 这对留任员工会产生负面影响，使他们也开始考虑自己是否也该离职。

sentences.text: So, what can be done to change this situation?
sentences.zh: 那么，该如何改变这一状况呢？

sentences.text: Firstly, managers should stop making basic errors which leave their staff feeling upset and resentful.
sentences.zh: 首先，管理者应停止犯下一些基础性错误，以免让员工感到沮丧和不满。

sentences.text: When organising shifts, for example, make sure you never give certain staff preferential treatment.
sentences.zh: 例如，在排班时，务必确保绝不给予某些员工特殊优待。

sentences.text: All staff should be given some choice about when they work, and everyone should have to work some evening and weekend shifts.
sentences.zh: 所有员工都应拥有一定的排班选择权，且每个人都需承担部分晚间及周末班次。

sentences.text: If you treat staff fairly, they'll be more likely to step in and help when extra staff are needed.
sentences.zh: 如果您公平对待员工，当需要额外人手时，他们就更有可能主动伸出援手。

sentences.text: Keeping staff happy has other tangible benefits for the business.
sentences.zh: 让员工保持满意，还能为企业带来其他切实可感的益处。

sentences.text: Take the Dunwich Hotel as an example.
sentences.zh: 以邓威奇酒店（Dunwich Hotel）为例。

sentences.text: It had been experiencing a problem with staff complaints and in order to deal with this, invested in staff training and improved staff conditions.
sentences.zh: 该酒店曾长期面临员工投诉问题；为解决这一问题，酒店投资加强了员工培训并改善了员工工作条件。

sentences.text: Not only did the level of complaints fall, but they also noticed a significant increase in the amount each customer spent during their stay.
sentences.zh: 结果不仅投诉量大幅下降，他们还注意到每位顾客在店期间的平均消费额显著上升。

sentences.text: They have now introduced a customer loyalty scheme which is going really well.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们已推出一项客户忠诚计划，效果非常好。

sentences.text: Now I'd like to look at some ways you can reduce staff turnover in your hotels, and I'll do this by giving some examples of hotels where I've done some training recently.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想通过介绍近期我为几家酒店开展培训的实际案例，来探讨一些降低贵酒店员工流动率的方法。

sentences.text: The Sun Club received feedback which showed that staff thought managers didn't value their opinions.
sentences.zh: 太阳俱乐部收到了反馈，显示员工认为经理并不重视他们的意见。

sentences.text: They weren't made to feel they were partners who were contributing to the success of the business as a whole.
sentences.zh: 他们没有被当作是为整个企业成功做出贡献的合作伙伴。

sentences.text: This situation has changed.
sentences.zh: 这种情况已经发生了改变。

sentences.text: Junior staff at all levels are regularly invited to meetings where their ideas are welcomed.
sentences.zh: 所有级别的初级员工都会定期受邀参加会议，他们的想法受到欢迎。

sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129

sentences.text: jeanne : Hi Thomas, how are you enjoying the course so far?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 嗨，Thomas，到目前为止，你对这门课程感觉如何？

sentences.text: thomas : Yeah, I think it's good.
sentences.zh: thomas: 嗯，我觉得挺不错的。

sentences.text: jeanne : Remind me – why did you decide to study sports science?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 提醒我一下——你当初为什么决定学习运动科学？

sentences.text: Didn't you want to be a professional athlete when you were at school?
sentences.zh: 你上学时不是想成为一名职业运动员吗？

sentences.text: thomas : Yeah – that was my goal, and all my classmates assumed I would achieve it; they thought I was brilliant.
sentences.zh: thomas: 是啊——那曾是我的目标，而且我所有的同学都认为我一定能实现；他们觉得我特别出色。

sentences.text: jeanne : That must have been a nice feeling.
sentences.zh: jeanne: 那种感觉一定很棒吧。

sentences.text: thomas : Mm, I thought I could win anything.
sentences.zh: thomas: 嗯，我当时觉得自己能赢下任何比赛。

sentences.text: There was no one who could run faster than me.
sentences.zh: 没人能跑得比我更快。

sentences.text: jeanne : Exactly – so what happened?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 没错——那么后来发生了什么？

sentences.text: Did your mum and dad want you to be more ‘academic'?
sentences.zh: 你父母是不是希望你更‘学术’一点？

sentences.text: thomas : Not at all.
sentences.zh: thomas: 完全不是。

sentences.text: Perhaps they should have pushed me harder, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，也许他们本该对我要求更严格些。

sentences.text: jeanne : What do you mean?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.text: thomas : I think I should have practised more.
sentences.zh: thomas: 我觉得我当时应该多加练习。

sentences.text: jeanne : What makes you say that?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 你为什么会这么说？

sentences.text: thomas : Well, I went out to Kenya for a couple of weeks to train …
sentences.zh: thomas: 嗯，我曾去肯尼亚训练了几个星期……

sentences.text: jeanne : Really!
sentences.zh: jeanne: 真的吗！

sentences.text: I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 我之前都不知道这事。

sentences.text: thomas : I was chosen to go there out of loads of kids and run with some of the top teenage athletes in the world.
sentences.zh: thomas: 我是从众多孩子中被选中前往那里，与世界上一些顶尖的青少年运动员一同训练。

sentences.text: And …
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.text: I was so calm about it.
sentences.zh: 我对这件事表现得异常平静。

sentences.text: I just kept thinking how fortunate I was.
sentences.zh: 我只是一直想着自己多么幸运。

sentences.text: What a great chance this was!
sentences.zh: 这是多么难得的机会啊！

sentences.text: Everyone back home was so proud of me.
sentences.zh: 家乡的每个人都为我感到骄傲。

sentences.text: But once we started competing, I very quickly realised I wasn't good enough.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我们开始比赛，我很快就意识到自己还不够优秀。

sentences.text: jeanne : That must have been a huge shock.
sentences.zh: jeanne: 这一定是个巨大的打击。

sentences.text: thomas : I thought ‘this can't be happening '!
sentences.zh: thomas: 我当时心想：‘这不可能发生！’

sentences.text: I was used to winning.
sentences.zh: 我早已习惯了获胜。

sentences.text: /22 /22 /24 /24 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts jeanne : I'm sorry to hear that.
sentences.zh: /22 /22 /24 /24 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts jeanne: 听到这个消息我很抱歉。

sentences.text: thomas : It's OK.
sentences.zh: thomas: 没关系。

sentences.text: I'm over it now and I think it's much better to do a university course and this one has such a variety of sports-related areas.
sentences.zh: 我现在已走出来了，而且我觉得读大学课程要好得多，而这一门课程涵盖了许多与体育相关的领域。

sentences.text: It's going to be good.
sentences.zh: 它会非常棒。

sentences.text: jeanne : Oh, I agree – I chose it because of that.
sentences.zh: jeanne: 哦，我完全同意——我当初选择它也正是出于这个原因。

sentences.text: thomas : So Jeanne – have you thought of any ideas for the discussion session next week on technology and sport?
sentences.zh: thomas: 那么Jeanne，你有没有为下周关于‘科技与体育’的讨论课想出什么点子？

sentences.text: jeanne : We have to cover more than one sport, don't we?
sentences.zh: jeanne: 我们得覆盖不止一项运动，对吧？

sentences.text: thomas : Yeah.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：是的。

sentences.text: jeanne : You know – we always think technology is about the future, but we could gather some ideas about past developments in sport.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：你知道——我们总以为科技关乎未来，但其实也可以搜集一些关于体育运动过去发展历程的资料。

sentences.text: thomas : Look at early types of equipment perhaps?
sentences.zh: 托马斯：或许可以看看早期的运动器材？

sentences.text: Uh, I remember reading something about table tennis bats once – how they ended up being covered with pimpled rubber.
sentences.zh: 呃，我记得以前读过一篇关于乒乓球拍的文章——它们最终被覆上了带颗粒的橡胶。

sentences.text: jeanne : Cos they were just wooden at first, I'd imagine.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：我猜最初只是木制的吧。

sentences.text: thomas : Yeah.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：是的。

sentences.text: In about the 1920s, a factory was making rolls of the rubber in bulk for something like horse harnesses.
sentences.zh: 大约在20世纪20年代，一家工厂大批量生产这种橡胶卷材，用途类似马具。

sentences.text: jeanne : Really!
sentences.zh: 珍妮：真的吗！

sentences.text: thomas : Yeah – and someone realised that it'd make a perfect covering for the wooden bats.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：是的——后来有人意识到，这种橡胶非常适合作为木制球拍的覆盖层。

sentences.text: jeanne : So what about cricket – that's had a few innovative changes.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：那板球呢——它也经历过不少创新性变革。

sentences.text: Maybe the pads they wear on their legs?
sentences.zh: 比如球员护腿用的护垫？

sentences.text: thomas : I don't think they've changed much but, I'm just looking on the internet … and it says that when the first cricket helmet came in, in 1978, the Australian batsman who first wore it was booed and jeered by people watching because it was so ugly!
sentences.zh: 托马斯：我觉得护垫本身变化不大，不过我刚上网查了一下……上面说，1978年首次出现板球头盔时，第一位佩戴它的澳大利亚击球手遭到了现场观众的嘘声和嘲笑，只因头盔外观实在太丑了！

sentences.text: jeanne : Wow, players have to protect themselves from getting hurt!
sentences.zh: 珍妮：哇，球员们必须保护自己免受伤害啊！

sentences.text: I mean everyone wears one now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，现在人人都戴头盔了。

sentences.text: thomas : Mm, unlike the cycle helmet.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：嗯，这跟自行车头盔可不一样。

sentences.text: jeanne : Well, unless you're a professional, but you're right, many ordinary bikers don't wear a helmet.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：嗯，除非你是职业选手；不过你说得对，许多普通骑行者并不戴头盔。

sentences.text: thomas : Hey, look at these pictures of original helmet designs.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：嘿，快看这些原始头盔设计的图片。

sentences.text: This one looks like an upside-down bowl!
sentences.zh: 这个看起来像个倒扣的碗！

sentences.text: jeanne : Yet, the woman's laughing – she's so proud to be wearing it!
sentences.zh: 珍妮：可那位女士却在笑——她戴着它还特别自豪呢！

sentences.text: thomas : It says serious cyclists ended up with wet hair from all the hard exercise.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：上面写着，严肃的自行车手因剧烈运动而满头大汗。

sentences.text: jeanne : I guess that's why they have large air vents in them now so that the skin can breathe more easily.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：我想这就是为什么如今头盔上都设计了大型通风孔，以便皮肤更易透气。

sentences.text: thomas : OK, so we've done helmets.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：好，头盔这部分我们已经讲完了。

sentences.text: What about golf balls or better still golf clubs – they've changed a lot.
sentences.zh: 那高尔夫球呢？或者更好的是高尔夫球杆——它们的变化可就大多了。

sentences.text: jeanne : Yeah – I remember my great grandfather telling me that because a club was made entirely of wood, it would easily break and players had to get another.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：是啊——我记得我曾祖父告诉过我，由于球杆完全由木材制成，很容易断裂，球员不得不另换一支。

sentences.text: thomas : There's no wood at all in them now, is there?
sentences.zh: 托马斯：现在球杆里一点木头都没有了吧？

sentences.text: jeanne : No – they're much more powerful.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：没有了——现在的球杆威力大得多。

sentences.text: thomas : The same must be true of hockey sticks.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：曲棍球杆应该也是如此。

sentences.text: jeanne : I don't think so because players still use wooden sticks today.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：我觉得未必，因为如今球员仍在使用木制球杆。

sentences.text: What it does say here, though, is that when the game started you had to produce a stick yourself.
sentences.zh: 不过这里提到，这项运动刚兴起时，球员得自己动手制作球杆。

sentences.text: thomas : I guess they just weren't being manufactured.
sentences.zh: 托马斯：我猜当时根本还没有量产。

sentences.text: So, one more perhaps.
sentences.zh: 那么，再举一个例子吧。

sentences.text: What about football?
sentences.zh: 足球呢？

sentences.text: jeanne : Well, I know the first balls were made of animal skin.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：哦，我知道最早的足球是用动物皮做的。

sentences.text: thomas : Yeah, they covered them with pieces of leather that were stitched together, but …
sentences.zh: 托马斯：是的，人们用缝合在一起的皮革片包裹球体，但……

sentences.text: the balls let in water when it rained.
sentences.zh: 下雨时球会渗水。

sentences.text: jeanne : Oh, that would have made them much heavier.
sentences.zh: 珍妮：哦，那样一来球就会重得多。

sentences.text: Hello everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.text: Today we're going to look at another natural food product and that's maple syrup.
sentences.zh: 今天我们将探讨另一种天然食品——枫糖浆。

sentences.text: What is this exactly?
sentences.zh: 这究竟是什么呢？

sentences.text: Well, maple syrup looks rather like clear honey, but it's not made by bees; it's produced from the plant fluid – or sap – inside the maple tree and that makes maple syrup a very natural product.
sentences.zh: 嗯，枫糖浆看起来很像清澈的蜂蜜，但它并非由蜜蜂酿制；而是从枫树内部的植物汁液（即树液）中提取制成，这使得枫糖浆成为一种非常天然的产品。

sentences.text: Maple syrup is a thick, golden , sweet-tasting liquid that can be bought in bottles or jars and poured onto food such as waffles and ice cream or used in the baking of cakes and pastries.
sentences.zh: 枫糖浆是一种浓稠、呈金黄色、味道甘甜的液体，通常以瓶装或罐装形式出售，可淋在华夫饼、冰淇淋等食物上，也可用于蛋糕和糕点的烘焙。

sentences.text: It contains no preservatives or added ingredients, and it provides a healthy alternative to refined sugar .
sentences.zh: 它不含防腐剂或任何添加成分，是精制糖的一种健康替代品。

sentences.text: Let's just talk a bit about the maple tree itself, which is where maple syrup comes from.
sentences.zh: 我们先简单谈谈枫树本身，因为枫糖浆正是源自这种树木。

sentences.text: So, there are many species of maple tree, and they'll grow without fertilizer in areas where there's plenty of moisture in the soil.
sentences.zh: 枫树有多个品种，只要土壤水分充足，它们便无需施肥即可生长。

sentences.text: However, they'll only do this if another important criterion is fulfilled, which is that they must have full or partial sun exposure during the day and very cool nights – and I'll talk more about that in a minute.
sentences.zh: 然而，要满足这一条件，还需具备另一项重要标准：即枫树在白天必须接受充分或部分日照，且夜间气温须极低——稍后我将对此作进一步说明。

sentences.text: There are only certain parts of the world that provide all these conditions: one is Canada, and by that, I mean all parts of Canada, and the other is the north-eastern states of North America.
sentences.zh: 全球仅有少数地区能同时满足上述所有条件：其一是加拿大（此处指加拿大全境），其二是北美洲东北部各州。

sentences.text: In these areas, the climate suits the trees perfectly.
sentences.zh: 在这些地区，气候条件与枫树的生长需求完美契合。

sentences.text: In fact, Canada produces over two-thirds of the world's maple syrup, which is why the five-pointed maple leaf is a Canadian symbol and has featured on the flag since 1964.
sentences.zh: 事实上，加拿大生产了全球三分之二以上的枫糖浆，因此五角枫叶成为加拿大的象征，并自1964年起被用作国旗图案。

sentences.text: So how did maple syrup production begin?
sentences.zh: 那么，枫糖浆的生产是如何起源的呢？

sentences.text: Well, long before Europeans settled in these parts of the world, the indigenous communities had started producing maple sugar.
sentences.zh: 早在欧洲人定居于这些地区之前，当地原住民社群便已开始制作枫糖。

sentences.text: They bored holes in the trunks of maple trees and used containers made of tree bark to collect the liquid sap as it poured out.
sentences.zh: 他们在枫树树干上钻孔，并用树皮制成的容器接取自然流出的树液。

sentences.text: As they were unable to keep the liquid for any length of time – they didn't have storage facilities in those days – they boiled the liquid by placing pieces of rock that had become scorching hot from the sun into the sap.
sentences.zh: 由于当时缺乏储存设施，他们无法长期保存这种液体，于是便将经烈日暴晒而灼热的石块投入树液中进行煮沸。

sentences.text: They did this until it turned into sugar, and they were then able to use this to sweeten their food and drinks.
sentences.zh: 他们持续这一过程直至液体结晶成糖，随后便可用其为食物和饮品增添甜味。

sentences.text: Since that time, improvements have been made to the process, but it has changed very little overall.
sentences.zh: 自那时起，制作工艺虽有所改进，但整体流程变化甚微。

sentences.text: So let's look at the production of maple syrup today.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们来看看当今枫糖浆的生产过程。

sentences.text: Clearly, the maple forests are a valuable resource in many Canadian and North American communities.
sentences.zh: 显然，枫树林是加拿大及北美许多社区的重要资源。

sentences.text: The trees have to be well looked after and they cannot be used to make syrup until the trunks reach a diameter of around 25 centimetres.
sentences.zh: 枫树需得到妥善养护，且只有当树干直径达到约25厘米时，方可用于熬制枫糖浆。

sentences.text: This can take anything up to 40 years.
sentences.zh: 这一过程可能耗时长达40年。

sentences.text: As I've already mentioned, maple trees need the right conditions to grow and also to produce sap.
sentences.zh: 正如我先前所提到的，枫树不仅需要适宜的生长条件，还需满足特定环境要求才能分泌树液。

sentences.text: Why is this?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.text: Well, what happens is that during a cold night, the tree absorbs water from the soil, and that rises through the tree's vascular system.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际情况是，在寒冷的夜晚，树木会从土壤中吸收水分，这些水分会通过树木的维管系统向上输送。

sentences.text: But then in the warmer daytime, the change in temperature causes the water to be pushed back down to the bottom of the tree.
sentences.zh: 但到了较温暖的白天，温度变化会使水分被推回树干底部。

sentences.text: This continual movement – up and down – leads to the formation of the sap needed for maple syrup production.
sentences.zh: 这种持续的上下运动——即水分的上升与下降——促成了枫糖浆生产所需树液的形成。

sentences.text: When the tree is ready, it can be tapped and this involves drilling a small hole into the trunk and inserting a tube into it that ends in a bucket.
sentences.zh: 当树木准备就绪时，便可进行采汁作业，这包括在树干上钻一个小孔，并插入一根导管，导管末端连接一个收集桶。

sentences.text: The trees can often take several taps, though the workers take care not to cause any damage to the healthy growth of the tree itself.
sentences.zh: 一棵树往往可以安装多个采汁口，不过工人们会小心操作，以免对树木本身的健康生长造成任何损害。

sentences.text: The sap that comes out of the trees consists of 98 percent water and 2 percent sugar and other nutrients.
sentences.zh: 从树中流出的树液含有98%的水和2%的糖分及其他营养物质。

sentences.text: It has to be boiled so that much of that water evaporates, and this process has to take place immediately, using what are called evaporators.
sentences.zh: 树液必须经过煮沸，使其中大部分水分蒸发；而且这一过程必须立即进行，所用设备称为‘蒸发器’。

sentences.text: These are basically extremely large pans – the sap is poured into these, a fire is built and the pans are then 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts heated until the sap boils.
sentences.zh: 这些蒸发器本质上是超大型平底锅——将树液倒入其中，生起火来加热平底锅，直至树液沸腾。

sentences.text: As it does this, the water evaporates, and the syrup begins to form.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，水分逐渐蒸发，枫糖浆开始形成。

sentences.text: The evaporation process creates large quantities of steam , and the sap becomes thicker and denser, and, at just the right moment, when the sap is thick enough to be called maple syrup, the worker removes it from the heat.
sentences.zh: 蒸发过程会产生大量蒸汽，树液随之变得越来越浓稠、密度越来越高；当树液达到恰到好处的浓稠度、可被称为枫糖浆时，工人便立即将其从热源上移开。

sentences.text: After this process, something called ‘sugar sand' has to be filtered out as this builds up during the boiling and gives the syrup a cloudy appearance and a slightly gritty taste.
sentences.zh: 完成此步骤后，还需过滤掉一种名为‘糖砂’的沉淀物，因为这种物质在熬煮过程中会不断析出，导致糖浆外观浑浊、口感略带颗粒感。

sentences.text: Once this has been done, the syrup is ready to be packaged so that it can be used for a whole variety of products.
sentences.zh: 完成过滤后，枫糖浆即可进行包装，以便用于各种产品。

sentences.text: It takes 40 litres of sap to produce one litre of maple syrup so you can get an idea of how much is needed!
sentences.zh: 生产1升枫糖浆需要40升树液，由此你可以想象所需树液量之大！

sentences.text: So that's the basic process.
sentences.zh: 以上便是基本的制作流程。

sentences.text: In places like Quebec where …
sentences.zh: 在魁北克等地……
